CustomField.description: API name of the autolaunched Flow that attaches uploaded files (ContentDocument/ContentVersion) to the converted records during conversion. Resolved and invoked by the Form_Submission_Convert__e trigger; must accept a Form_Submission_Convert__e input. Blank uses the package's default file-processing Flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Advanced override: API name of the Flow that attaches files uploaded on the form to the converted records. Leave blank to use the default file-upload conversion Flow.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName (File Upload)
